slot.intent: What they said, set against what they did.

concept: One claim builds at the centre; the pivot word lands, folds into a dashed seam that splits the frame, and the second claim builds opposite, the same red mark on both verbs.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "What": the first claim builds word by word at the centre in heavy sentence case, grey settling to off white
1.7 s, on "said,": said lands and a flat red highlighter sweeps behind it in one stroke
2.6 s, on "against": the pivot lands under the claim at the claim's size in off white and holds its own beat
3.15 s: the claim slides aside into its half as against closes from both ends to a sliver at its centre, and the dashed seam grows out of the sliver across the frame
3.4 s, on "what": the second claim builds in the other half, the same gap from the seam as the first, which steps back to mid grey, its red mark kept
5.1 s, on "did.": did lands and the same red highlighter sweeps behind it, so the halves mirror each other; a full hold to the end

leansOn.why: Words build grey to off white as spoken, and one flat red highlighter sweep marks the key word as it lands.
